matches.rationale: No report finding addresses the missing 128-byte account storage overhead in the minimum deposit calculation.
No finding about the PDA bump being passed in as a user-supplied instruction argument.
Finding 5 is about not checking the destination chainId parameter. It does not mention MessageSent emitting the Ethereum chain id as the destination.
No finding about msg! log truncation.
Finding 1 says the nonce is predictable or can be manipulated. That is a different root cause from collisions caused by the 64-bit width with no reuse check.
No finding about addressArrayInitialized accepting an empty array.
Finding 17 covers general relayer centralization (availability, censorship). It does not say the relayer account holds custody of bridged funds.
No finding about missing _disableInitializers in the implementation constructors.
No finding about invoke_signed being used where invoke would do.
Finding 13 identifies the fixed 1024-byte sizes of Configuration and WithdrawalReceipt as oversized.
